messages.content: Build a complete offline three.js tactical FPS for the make.fun bounty threejs-fps-02 under the name BLACKSITE: PROTOCOL. Requirements: 5v5 vs bots, round-based, buy phase, plant/defuse objective, PC + mobile controls, responsive, distinctive visual identity, credits to blitz/blitzlabx, pure static files, vendor/makefun-threejs.ts unchanged.

Implemented BLACKSITE: PROTOCOL as a pure ES-module three.js tactical FPS. Delivered full round loop, bot AI, weapons, economy, objectives, lobby, buy menu, HUD, mobile + desktop controls, screenshots, main.ts static server, and OSI-approved MIT license. All work performed in web AI tools that leave no local session files.
